## Code Review

This pull request centralizes the canary failure detection pattern into a local variable within the `_dispatch_triage_review_worker` function. The review feedback suggests promoting this variable to a script-level `readonly` constant for better centralization and separating the `local` declaration from the assignment to ensure exit code safety. Additionally, a suggestion was made to use the `--` separator in the `grep` command to prevent the pattern from being interpreted as a command-line flag.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces a mechanism to carry forward the diff of a PR closed due to merge conflicts to its linked GitHub issue, enabling subsequent workers to reuse previous efforts. The implementation includes a new function, _carry_forward_pr_diff, featuring size-capping and idempotency guards, supported by a new test suite. Review feedback highlights critical improvements for robustness: verifying the success of the issue body fetch to prevent accidental data loss and using stdin for body updates to avoid potential command-line argument length limits.

## Code Review

This pull request streamlines the documentation and internal comments for the _resolve_scripts_dir function in test-bash-reexec-guard.sh. The changes clarify that a single relative-path step is sufficient to resolve the scripts directory for both git worktree and deployed layouts. I have no feedback to provide as there were no review comments.

## Code Review

This pull request improves the reliability of the bash upgrade helper and expands the search for compatible bash versions. In `bash-upgrade-helper.sh`, the logic for updating the dismissed advisories file was modified to include a file existence check. In `shared-constants.sh`, the bash re-execution logic now includes the system's default bash as a candidate, provided it meets specific criteria. Feedback was provided regarding a potential data loss issue in `bash-upgrade-helper.sh` where masking `grep` errors with `|| true` could lead to overwriting the configuration file with a partial or empty temporary file; a more robust exit code check was suggested.

## Code Review

This pull request optimizes GitHub API usage in `.agents/scripts/dispatch-dedup-pr.sh` by consolidating multiple keyword searches into a single query and fetching PR bodies in the initial list request to avoid subsequent `gh pr view` calls. It also improves variable scoping and logging for stale assignments in `.agents/scripts/dispatch-dedup-stale.sh`. The review feedback identifies a potential regression where using `--limit 1` with the consolidated query might lead to false negatives if the first returned PR is a false positive; it is recommended to increase the limit and filter results using a single `jq` pass to maintain detection accuracy.

## Code Review

This pull request introduces several improvements to the Higgsfield API client and video processing scripts. Key changes include refactoring `apiDownloadFile` to use streams for better memory efficiency, updating credential parsing regex for better flexibility, and simplifying video filenames by removing timestamps. Additionally, the `verify-cluster.sh` script was updated to reduce redundant command executions when checking for code smells. Feedback was provided to further optimize the shell script by consolidating `jq` calls and using `mapfile` to handle output more idiomatically.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the documentation in .agents/workflows/brief/tier-standard.md to clarify the purpose of the '### Done When' section and the necessity of fallback searches. The review feedback suggests reformatting these instructions into a bulleted list to improve clarity and ensure operational details are explicit.

## Code Review

This pull request updates the token spend extraction logic in `.agents/scripts/dispatch-dedup-cost.sh` to support a 'days' time unit and refactors the `sed` command for collapsing time infixes. A review comment identifies a potential issue with the greedy `.*` pattern in the `sed` command, which could lead to incorrect token counts if multiple footers appear on the same line, and provides a more specific regex suggestion.

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the pre-dispatch validators documentation to be more concise. The review feedback focuses on correcting grammatical ambiguities introduced by the condensation, ensuring that institutional memory regarding post-mortem references and the rationale for bypass restrictions is preserved, and improving the readability of operational details through bulleted lists.

## Code Review

This pull request reorganizes the shell style guide by moving the "Why this rule exists" section to the top of the document for better visibility and refines the description of issues related to unguarded readonly assignments. A review comment suggests updating the audit data within this section to include test harnesses, which provides a more accurate representation of the project's technical debt.
